items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Mildred Brown is introduced by the interviewer as a participant in the recording session ('And yours? Mildred Brown.'), but the interviewee does not mention her or describe any personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: I see. I see. And let's get everybody's name down here who's here today. Want to put yours on? Yeah. I'm Gudrun Schreiner. Uh-huh. And yours? Mildred Brown. And yours? And George Brown. And I'm Dick Allen. All right? Now, proceed with the questions. George, you were asking him one that you were interested in.

Oh, Mr. Charles, I'm very much interested in knowing. How many of the men with whom you associated in the early days of jazz and New Orleans were Protestant and Catholic? I think this is important. Could you tell us?
